sentences.text: By consent of the parties, the writ petition is taken up for final disposal.

2.The petitioner has come forward with this writ petition seeking a direction to the first respondent to take appropriate action against the edible oil manufactures, Wholesale and Retail Vendors for selling unlabelled edible oil in not properly packed packages in Singampunari Town Panchayat and thereby taking disciplinary action against the 3rd respondent for his failure in discharging his duty as per the Food Safety and Standard Act, http://www.judis.nic.in 200,6 based on the petitioner's representation dated 11.02.2019 within a stipulated time.
3.The petitioner would submit that he is an Advocate by profession and he is having Office at Big Bazaar street in Singampunari Taluk.
There are Oil Mills, wholesale and retail vendors in the Panchayat and the yearly turn over crosses several crores of rupees in the edible oil business.
4.The learned counsel would allege that some money minded persons are indulging in selling adulterated edible oils without any label and properly packaged package.
They are simply mixing the low price edible oils with the high price edible oil irrespective of edible oil varieties.
Hence, he made several whatsapp complaints.
He also submitted a written complaint dated 11.02.2019 to the respondents.
Since no action has been taken by the respondents, the present writ petition has been filed.
http://www.judis.nic.in 5.The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that it is suffice, if the representation of the petitioner is considered by the respondents.
6.The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would submit that the representation of the petitioner would be considered in accordance with law.

7.In the light of the above facts and the submissions of the learned counsels, this Court, without going into the merits of the matter, directs the first respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner, dated 11.02.2019 and take appropriate action purely on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
8.With the above direction, this writ petition is disposed of.
No costs.
